description: Configuration header for the Flash Driver in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, defining parameters, structures, and macros for Flash memory management specific to MPC5604B MCU.

methods.name: FlsAcErase
methods.description: Function pointer for Flash erase operation (not supported).

methods.name: FlsAcWrite
methods.description: Function pointer for Flash write operation (not supported).

methods.description: Callback for successful Flash job completion.

methods.description: Callback for Flash job error handling.
